_help: Catalog for the Your Walk reading tracker badges. Each badge has a stable id (used as the row key in the WalkBadges Sheet tab — DO NOT rename ids after launch), a human-readable name shown on the celebration card, a description shown under the name, and an unlockRule string that maps to one of the evaluator functions in evaluateBadgeUnlocks_ inside docs/apps-script/order-handler.gs. To add a new badge: append an entry, deploy a fresh /exec from the Apps Script editor, bump the badges.json cache buster on community.html. See admin-help.html#your-walk for the full walkthrough.

badges.name: First chapter back
badges.description: You stamped your first day. Welcome back to the Word.

badges.name: Faithful in the small things
badges.description: Five days a week for four weeks running. Luke 16:10 — whoever can be trusted with very little can also be trusted with much.

badges.name: Walked through the Gospel of John
badges.description: Twenty-one chapters of John, one at a time. You walked the road with him.

badges.name: Sat with the Psalmists for 30 days
badges.description: A month of psalms. The Psalter has been your companion.

badges.name: 30-day walk
badges.description: Thirty days, with the three-day grace. Faithful, not perfect — that is the point.
